purpose: Machine-readable description of the current web UI so future work matches the real front-end in apps/web instead of the older sharp-minimal snapshot.

approach.rule: Treat apps/web as one brand system with multiple surface families: public marketing, public docs, public auth, and authenticated workspace.
approach.important_note: Do not collapse all apps/web routes into one flat dashboard aesthetic. Shared DNA exists, but each surface family has its own geometry, spacing, and chrome.

brand_dna.platform_context: Anan web serves both public institutional storytelling and authenticated real-estate operations for brokers, developers, and assistant-led work.
anti_character: heavy shadow stacks on every card
brand_dna.house_rule: Use Cairo, blue signal emphasis, disciplined slate or zinc neutrals, and structural borders before decorative effects.

theming.provider: next-themes with class-based dark mode and system fallback
theming.selection_style: blue-tinted selection background with foreground text preserved

internationalization.rtl: first-class for Arabic-first public and workspace experiences
internationalization.direction_rule: Resolve direction per route and sometimes per message content; do not assume global LTR.

case_rules.arabic: keep natural Arabic rhythm and weight
case_rules.english_microcopy: often uppercase in labels, nav, badges, and CTA copy

palette_rules: Blue is the primary signal color, not the default background fill for whole pages.
Slate and zinc neutrals carry most surfaces.
Success, warning, and destructive accents appear semantically in docs, alerts, and workspace status.

geometry.border_strategy: Borders are primary structure; shadows are restrained and secondary.
geometry.shadow_strategy: Use soft low-elevation shadows on floating chrome, avatars, premium cards, and composer shells.

motion.philosophy: Motion should clarify state and add polish without dominating the interface.
observed_patterns: subtle hover background and border shifts
short shell and page enter animations
looping vector motion on public landing visuals
assistant mic meter and small framer-motion transitions
timing_bias: longer ambient loops only for public brand visuals

public_marketing.style_summary: Editorial institutional marketing with strong Cairo display type, fixed blurred navbar, alternating section bands, vector-led storytelling, and blue CTA emphasis.
layout_rules: Use a fixed top navbar with blurred white or dark glass chrome.
Use large section padding, commonly 24 to 32 spacing units vertically.
Use a max content width around 1400px.
Alternate white, pale slate, dark slate, blue, and occasional glass or gradient surfaces.

hero_rules.title: Very large black Cairo headings with a blue emphasis line or segment.
hero_rules.badge: Tiny uppercase microcopy with wide tracking and minimal icon markers.
hero_rules.description: High-weight body copy, often with a right border accent in blue for Arabic layouts.
hero_rules.ctas: Primary is blue fill, secondary is outline or dark fill.

navbar.tone: white or dark translucent with backdrop blur
navbar.links: text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-widest with muted idle state and blue hover

sections.dividers: optional bottom 2px borders on section transitions

visual_language: Vector-led and signal-led instead of screenshot-first marketing.
Low-opacity grid textures and branded SVG fields are acceptable.
Ambient motion should remain subtle and diagrammatic.
do_not: Do not turn marketing pages into a generic SaaS gradient landing page.
Do not replace vector storytelling with random stock art.
Do not make every section blue.

public_docs.style_summary: Public developer docs use a polished technical-doc shell with a sticky blurred top nav, white or near-black panels, clearer hard borders than marketing, and dark code surfaces.
layout_rules: Docs are LTR by default even inside the Arabic-first app.
Use a sidebar plus sticky top nav shell.
Keep main article width tighter than marketing, around 800px within a 5xl shell.

top_nav.tone: sticky, blurred, low-noise white or dark chrome

sidebar.tone: white or dark panel with grouped navigation labels
sidebar.active_state: soft slate background instead of full blue fill

article_headers.eyebrow: blue outlined badge with uppercase black tracking
article_headers.title: large uppercase black

endpoint_cards.border: 2px outer border with hard section dividers

code_blocks.copy_action: floating small ghost action on hover

do_not: Do not style docs like the marketing landing page.
Do not remove the harder technical contrast from code examples and endpoint cards.

public_auth.style_summary: Sign-in is a focused institutional auth surface: centered single-column cardless composition, blue trust icon, clear legal microcopy, and minimal distraction.
layout_rules: Center the content vertically inside a public section shell.
Keep width narrow and focused, around a max-md container.
Use the shared public font and background tokens.

component_patterns.hero_icon: rounded-2xl blue square with soft blue glow shadow
component_patterns.title: 4xl black heading
component_patterns.legal_copy: tiny uppercase tracked links with blue accents
component_patterns.trust_strip: two-column row separated by a top border

workspace_web.style_summary: Quiet premium operational shell built from workspace variables, sidebar plus compact top navbar chrome, assistant-first canvases, rounded panels, and selective blue state emphasis.
layout_rules: Use a responsive shell with persistent desktop sidebar and mobile drawer.
Top navbar is compact and panel-toned, not loud chrome.
Workspace pages are height-aware and overflow-managed.
Content should feel breathable and operational rather than overloaded.

sidebar.items: rounded-xl rows or icon pills with muted idle state and blue active emphasis

top_nav.shape: trailing rounded action cluster over workspace-panel

panels.default: workspace-panel with workspace-border and restrained shadow

page_headers.title: tight black or strong foreground heading
page_headers.description: short bold support copy with muted tone

filters_and_tabs.active_pattern: blue fill or blue-tinted border depending on context
filters_and_tabs.tab_rule: border-led and editorial rather than heavily decorative

empty_states.copy: centered strong title plus muted support text

message_rows.assistant_avatar: rounded 20px to 3xl white or dark card with AI motion logo
message_rows.assistant_body: often open typographic markdown instead of a boxed bubble
message_rows.user_bubble: dark rounded asymmetric bubble with strong contrast

composer.shell: large rounded-[32px] translucent shell with blur and subtle white border
composer.send_button: filled circular dark button when active, muted when idle

attachments.surface: white or dark panel with image preview and small metadata footer

brand_subsystem.vector_panels: inline SVG signal geometry with blue, emerald, or slate accent variants
brand_subsystem.section_frames: clean white bands, hard borders, strong headings
brand_subsystem.stat_strips: structured grids with bold values and restrained decoration

do_not: Do not turn workspace into a bright blue dashboard.
Do not flatten all workspace surfaces to one 8px radius.
Do not use generic chatbot gradients or neon AI glow treatments.
Do not ignore mixed RTL and LTR content rules inside assistant threads.

institutional_public_button.style: uppercase, high-weight, wide tracking, blue or dark fill, strong press-scale feedback

workspace_icon_actions.shape: rounded-xl or rounded-full depending on location
workspace_icon_actions.tone: panel on panel with restrained shadow

badges_and_chips.copy_style: micro labels frequently use font-black and tracking
badges_and_chips.active_pattern: filled blue, filled dark, or blue-tinted surface
badges_and_chips.inactive_pattern: neutral elevated or bordered surface with muted text

forms.workspace_and_auth: clean field framing, generous spacing, blue focus ring, no busy helper chrome
forms.docs: technical and harder-edged inputs are acceptable inside code and docs tooling contexts

llm_transfer_rules: Choose the correct surface family before composing new UI.
Keep Cairo as the default face and blue as the primary emphasis token.
Use semantic tokens and workspace variables instead of hardcoding every surface color.
Preserve dark mode and RTL behavior where the existing routes support them.
Prefer borders, spacing, and typography hierarchy before adding more decoration.
Keep assistant UI calm, premium, and trustworthy.
